opportunitiesData.title: DoD Fleet Telematics & IoT Diagnostic Software Platform
opportunitiesData.fullParentPathName: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPARTMENT OF THE ARMY.AMC.ACC
opportunitiesData.description: The US Army Contracting Command is seeking a small business vendor to deliver enterprise fleet telematics and real-time IoT diagnostic data ingestion across tactical and non-tactical vehicles. Proposers must demonstrate at least 5 years of prior experience deploying IoT telematics software and maintain cyber liability insurance of at least $2,000,000.

opportunitiesData.title: US Treasury Core Financial Infrastructure Modernization
opportunitiesData.fullParentPathName: DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY.INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE
opportunitiesData.description: Internal Revenue Service requires prime vendor to modernize mainframe accounting ledgers. Proposers must demonstrate a minimum of 15 years of prior experience managing sovereign transactional systems and maintain active SAM.gov registration. General liability of $10,000,000 is required.
